conventions.doc: each case runs on a fresh temp --doc; plan / plan_file first (llull run … --json), then cli calls with --json
conventions.alias: <alias:NAME> = first id in affected of the plan step whose "as" is NAME
conventions.first: <first:PATH> = the value at PATH (e.g. data.matches[0].id of find_entities) in the previous call's --json output
conventions.paths: dot paths into the --json object (a single command that fails reports error.code / error.paths / error.remediation beside data; a plan reports data.steps[i].error); [*] maps over an array; [?field==value] filters
conventions.status: all cases run against the built commands (server/tests/packReplay07.test.ts replays them through runCli); VC-FTR-46 needs the pinned CTC-02 (npm run quality:fetch)
